svg.title: Design response spectra, ASCE 7-22 and EN 1998-1
svg.desc: Chart of spectral acceleration (g) against period from 0 to 3 s. ASCE 7-22 two-period design spectrum with SDS = 0.80 g, SD1 = 0.40 g: plateau from 0.1 to 0.5 s, then SD1/T. EN 1998-1 Type 1 spectrum, ground type B, ag = 0.20 g: elastic plateau 0.60 g (dashed) and design spectrum with q = 3.9, plateau 0.154 g. The office building period 0.533 s is marked.
